purpose: Select the next economically useful and currently non-duplicative data path for the fixed three-session strategy after the official-exchange inquiry source rejection, without observing a QMT runtime, QMT row, minute factor value, or minute-factor return.

sources.title: XtQuant FAQ
observed_contract: XtQuant requires a local MiniQMT client runtime
XtData supplies historical and real-time K-lines
the historical cache and Python runtime are local to the user's QMT environment

reasons: It supplies the intraday path information missing from daily OHLC rather than another daily or announcement-field variant.
The exact five factor formulas and directions were frozen before any local one-minute snapshot existed.
Level-1 time, OHLC, volume, amount, suspension state, no-adjustment, and no-fill controls are sufficient for source acceptance and daily reconciliation.
A Windows-side export bundle separates the lawful broker runtime from the macOS research repository and prevents credentials, account details, or client paths from entering Git.
The official interface documents Level-2 data as subscription or local-cache data, and no lawful historical entitlement is visible in this workspace.
No lower-cost Level-1 minute factor has passed source coverage, association, Top-3, and execution gates.
Queue data is not required to validate the five existing path factors.
The current frontier already exhausts price-path, moneyflow, ownership, analyst, institutional-survey, financing, accounting, disclosure-burden, and supervisory-event neighbors.
Selecting another field after the terminal outcomes would be a same-source or same-mechanism sweep rather than a clean independent hypothesis.

implementation_decision.first_allowed_external_action: Run only the fixed four-symbol completed-session acceptance exporter inside an already-lawful Windows MiniQMT/XtQuant environment.
implementation_decision.first_allowed_local_action: Fingerprint-validate and import only that acceptance bundle, reconcile it to accepted raw daily data, and stop before full history or factor values.
